   - “Hand person A the level” — no level is visible, and no indication of such an action.
   - “Explain the lesson to person A” — not an educational setting.
   - “Bring person A their check” — no financial context.

7. Justification 2 — “None of these justifications is appropriate” — matches the reasoning, as none of the justifications (guidance, instruction, financial handling, assisting) fit the actual context of a construction site with no clear interaction.
